-- Shared adapter for imported monster looks; all gameplay stays in GuardService.
local Config=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local M={}
local function bounds(model)
 local lo,hi
 for _,p in model:GetDescendants() do if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency<1 then
  local cf=p.CFrame local half=p.Size/2
  for x=-1,1,2 do for y=-1,1,2 do for z=-1,1,2 do
   local v=cf*Vector3.new(half.X*x,half.Y*y,half.Z*z)
   lo=lo and lo:Min(v) or v hi=hi and hi:Max(v) or v
  end end end
 end end
 assert(lo,"Monster has no visible geometry")
 return (lo+hi)/2,hi-lo
end
function M.Build(name,position)
 local model=Instance.new("Model") model.Name=name
 local root=Instance.new("Part") root.Name="GuardRoot" root.Size=Config.GuardSize
 root.Transparency=1 root.Anchored=true root.CanCollide=false root.CanTouch=false root.CanQuery=false
 root.CFrame=CFrame.new(position) root.Parent=model model.PrimaryPart=root
 local visual=game.ServerStorage.MonsterTemplates[name]:Clone() visual.Name="Visual" visual.PrimaryPart=nil visual.Parent=model
 local center,size=bounds(visual)
 -- Some supplied skinned runners were imported lying on their backs.
 if size.Y<size.Z/2 then visual:PivotTo(CFrame.new(center)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)*CFrame.new(-center)*visual:GetPivot()) end
 center,size=bounds(visual)
 visual:ScaleTo(visual:GetScale()*Config.MonsterGuards.Heights[name]/size.Y)
 center,size=bounds(visual)
 visual.WorldPivot=CFrame.new(center)
 visual:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position.X,Config.GroundY+size.Y/2,position.Z))
 local joints,effects={},{} local light
 for _,p in visual:GetDescendants() do
  if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Anchored=true p.CanCollide=false p.CanTouch=false p.CanQuery=false p.CastShadow=false
  elseif p:IsA("Humanoid") then p.DisplayDistanceType=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None p.HealthDisplayType=Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff p.EvaluateStateMachine=false
  elseif p:IsA("JointInstance") and p.Part0 and p.Part1 then
   table.insert(joints,{Part0=p.Part0,Part1=p.Part1,C0=p.C0,C1=p.C1,Animated=p:IsA("Motor6D")})
  elseif p:IsA("WeldConstraint") and p.Part0 and p.Part1 then
   table.insert(joints,{Part0=p.Part0,Part1=p.Part1,C0=p.Part0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.Part1.CFrame),C1=CFrame.identity,Animated=false})
  elseif p:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then p.Enabled=false p.Rate=math.min(p.Rate,Config.MonsterGuards.ParticleRate) table.insert(effects,p)
  elseif p:IsA("Trail") or p:IsA("Beam") then p.Enabled=false table.insert(effects,p)
  elseif p:IsA("Light") then
   if Config.MonsterGuards.BodyGlowDesigns[name] or light then p:Destroy()
   else
    light=p p.Enabled=false p.Shadows=false
    p.Brightness=math.min(p.Brightness,Config.MonsterGuards.LightBrightness)
    p.Range=math.min(p.Range,Config.MonsterGuards.LightRange)
    table.insert(effects,p)
   end
  end
 end
 if Config.MonsterGuards.BodyGlowDesigns[name] then
  local glow=Instance.new("Highlight") glow.Name="BodyGlow" glow.Adornee=visual
  glow.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded glow.FillColor=Config.MonsterGuards.BodyGlowColor
  glow.FillTransparency=Config.MonsterGuards.BodyGlowTransparency glow.OutlineTransparency=1
  glow.Enabled=false glow.Parent=model table.insert(effects,glow)
 end
 model:SetAttribute("MonsterDesign",name)
 local view={visual=visual,height=size.Y,width=size.X,depth=size.Z,joints=joints,effects=effects}
 M.Pose(view,root,false,0)
 return model,view
end
function M.SetEffects(view,enabled)
 for _,e in view.effects do e.Enabled=enabled end
end
function M.Pose(view,root,moving,now)
 local c=Config.MonsterGuards
 local wave=moving and math.sin(now*c.WalkFrequency) or 0
 view.visual:PivotTo(CFrame.new(root.Position.X,Config.GroundY+view.height/2+math.abs(wave)*c.WalkBob,root.Position.Z)*root.CFrame.Rotation)
 -- Pose anchored rig parts directly, avoiding imported animation dependencies.
 local pending=table.clone(view.joints) local children={}
 for _,j in pending do children[j.Part1]=true end
 local done={}
 for _,j in pending do if not children[j.Part0] then done[j.Part0]=true end end
 for _=1,#pending do
  local progress=false
  for i=#pending,1,-1 do local j=pending[i] if done[j.Part0] then
   local n=j.Part1.Name:lower() local angle=0
   if j.Animated and (n:find("arm") or n:find("leg")) then angle=wave*c.WalkAngle*(n:find("left") and 1 or -1) end
   local rest=0
   if j.Animated and n:find("arm") and j.Part1.Size.X>j.Part1.Size.Y*2 then rest=(n:find("left") and 1 or -1)*c.HorizontalArmRestAngle end
   j.Part1.CFrame=j.Part0.CFrame*j.C0*CFrame.Angles(angle,0,rest)*j.C1:Inverse()
   done[j.Part1]=true table.remove(pending,i) progress=true
  end end
  if not progress then break end
 end
end
return M
Server/GuardService.luau:
--[[
	GuardService: simple NPC guards. Each stage has Config.GuardCountPerStage[stage] guards that
	patrol random points inside their own stage zone and chase the nearest player in range.
	A guard that touches a player knocks them back (the hit client applies the impulse) and makes
	them drop their card. No pathfinding: guards move in a straight line, clamped to their zone.
	Guards only update while a player is within Config.GuardActivationDistance of their stage;
	otherwise they stand still and the Heartbeat connection is disconnected entirely.
]]

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)

local MonsterFactory = require(script.Parent.MonsterFactory)
local GuardService = {}

local CardService -- injected in Init
local guardsFolder = Workspace:WaitForChild("Greybox"):WaitForChild("Guards")
local rng = Random.new()
local zones = {}    -- [stage] = floor part
local guards = {}   -- [stage] = { { model, stage, waypoint, stunUntil }, ... }
local active = {}   -- [stage] = true while a player is near
local hitUntil = {} -- [Player] = os.clock() until which the player is immune
local heartbeat: RBXScriptConnection?

local function pointIn(zone: Part, margin: number?): Vector3
	local reach = zone.Size / 2 - Vector3.one * (margin or Config.GuardZoneMargin)
	return Vector3.new(
		zone.Position.X + rng:NextNumber(-reach.X, reach.X),
		Config.GroundY + Config.GuardSize.Y / 2,
		zone.Position.Z + rng:NextNumber(-reach.Z, reach.Z)
	)
end

local function clampToZone(position: Vector3, zone: Part, margin: number?): Vector3
	local reach = zone.Size / 2 - Vector3.one * (margin or Config.GuardZoneMargin)
	return Vector3.new(
		math.clamp(position.X, zone.Position.X - reach.X, zone.Position.X + reach.X),
		position.Y,
		math.clamp(position.Z, zone.Position.Z - reach.Z, zone.Position.Z + reach.Z)
	)
end

local function createGuard(stage: number,index: number)
 local zone=zones[stage]
 local list=Config.MonsterGuards.Stages[stage]
 local design=list[(index-1)%#list+1]
 local model,view=MonsterFactory.Build(design,pointIn(zone))
 local margin=Config.GuardZoneMargin+math.max(view.width,view.depth)/2
 model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pointIn(zone,margin)))
 MonsterFactory.Pose(view,model.PrimaryPart,false,0)
 model.Name="Guard_Stage"..stage.."_"..index
 model:SetAttribute("Stage",stage)
 CollectionService:AddTag(model,"Guard")
 model.Parent=guardsFolder
 table.insert(guards[stage],{model=model,view=view,stage=stage,waypoint=pointIn(zone,margin),margin=margin,stunUntil=0})
end

local function livingTargets(): { { player: Player, root: BasePart } }
	local targets = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			table.insert(targets, { player = player, root = root })
		end
	end
	return targets
end

local function hit(guard, target, now: number)
	hitUntil[target.player] = now + Config.GuardHitCooldownSeconds
	guard.stunUntil = now + Config.GuardStunSeconds
	local away = target.root.Position - guard.model.PrimaryPart.Position
	local flat = Vector3.new(away.X, 0, away.Z)
	local direction = flat.Magnitude > 0 and flat.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
	Remotes.Knockback:FireClient(target.player, direction * Config.GuardKnockbackSpeed + Vector3.new(0, Config.GuardKnockbackUp, 0))
	CardService.DropCarried(target.player)
end

local function updateGuard(guard, targets, dt: number, now: number)
	if now < guard.stunUntil then MonsterFactory.Pose(guard.view,guard.model.PrimaryPart,false,now) return end
	local stage, zone = guard.stage, zones[guard.stage]
	local position = guard.model.PrimaryPart.Position

	local nearest, nearestDistance
	for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
		local offset = target.root.Position - position
		if offset.Magnitude <= Config.GuardHitRadius and (hitUntil[target.player] or 0) <= now then
			hit(guard, target, now)
			return
		end
		local flat = Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z).Magnitude
		if flat <= Config.GuardChaseRange[stage] and (not nearestDistance or flat < nearestDistance) then
			nearest, nearestDistance = target, flat
		end
	end

	local destination, speed
	if nearest then
		destination, speed = nearest.root.Position, Config.GuardChaseSpeed[stage]
	else
		if Vector3.new(guard.waypoint.X - position.X, 0, guard.waypoint.Z - position.Z).Magnitude <= Config.GuardWaypointReach then
			guard.waypoint = pointIn(zone,guard.margin)
		end
		destination, speed = guard.waypoint, Config.GuardChaseSpeed[stage] * Config.GuardPatrolSpeedFactor
	end

	local delta = Vector3.new(destination.X - position.X, 0, destination.Z - position.Z)
	if delta.Magnitude < 0.01 then MonsterFactory.Pose(guard.view,guard.model.PrimaryPart,false,now) return end
	local nextPosition = clampToZone(position + delta.Unit * math.min(speed * dt, delta.Magnitude), zone,guard.margin)
	guard.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(nextPosition, nextPosition + delta.Unit))
 MonsterFactory.Pose(guard.view,guard.model.PrimaryPart,true,now)
end

local function step(dt: number)
	local now = os.clock()
	local targets = livingTargets()
	for stage in pairs(active) do
		for _, guard in ipairs(guards[stage]) do
			updateGuard(guard, targets, dt, now)
		end
	end
end

local function distanceToZone(position: Vector3, zone: Part): number
	local offset = position - zone.Position
	local dx = math.max(math.abs(offset.X) - zone.Size.X / 2, 0)
	local dz = math.max(math.abs(offset.Z) - zone.Size.Z / 2, 0)
	return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
end

--- Work out which stages have a player nearby; only those are simulated.
local function refreshActive()
	table.clear(active)
	for _, target in ipairs(livingTargets()) do
		for stage, zone in pairs(zones) do
			if distanceToZone(target.root.Position, zone) <= Config.GuardActivationDistance then
				active[stage] = true
			end
		end
	end
	for _,list in guards do for _,guard in list do
  local near=false
  for _,target in livingTargets() do if (target.root.Position-guard.model.PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude<=Config.MonsterGuards.EffectsDistance then near=true break end end
  MonsterFactory.SetEffects(guard.view,near)
  guard.model:SetAttribute("Active",active[guard.stage]==true)
 end end
 local anyActive = next(active) ~= nil
	if anyActive and not heartbeat then
		heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)
	elseif not anyActive and heartbeat then
		heartbeat:Disconnect()
		heartbeat = nil
	end
end

function GuardService.Init(cardService)
	CardService = cardService
	for _, floor in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("StageZone")) do
		zones[floor:GetAttribute("Stage")] = floor
	end
	for stage in pairs(zones) do
		guards[stage] = {}
		for index = 1, Config.GuardCountPerStage[stage] do
			createGuard(stage,index)
		end
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) hitUntil[player] = nil end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			refreshActive()
			task.wait(Config.GuardActivationCheckSeconds)
		end
	end)
end

return GuardService
Server/PickaxeService.luau:
--[[
	PickaxeService: server-side mining and fighting.
	The Pickaxe Tool lives in StarterPack (edit it in Studio). When a player activates it
	(mouse click, phone tap, gamepad - Tool.Activated replicates to the server) we:
	  1. enforce a per-player cooldown,
	  2. find the nearest target in range and in front: a cube, or another player carrying a card,
	  3. damage the cube / make the player drop their card,
	  4. play the swing animation (default Animate script reads a "toolanim" StringValue) and a hit/miss sound.
	No client raycasts and no remotes are involved.
]]

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local LineOfSight = require(script.Parent.LineOfSight)

local PickaxeService = {}

local CubeService, CardService -- injected in Init
local lastSwing = {} -- [Player] = os.clock()

--- Distance to `position` if it is within range and in front of (or very close to) the root.
local function reachDistance(root: BasePart, position: Vector3): number?
	local offset = position - root.Position
	local distance = offset.Magnitude
	if distance > Config.PickaxeRange then return nil end
	if distance <= Config.PickaxeCloseRange then return distance end
	local flat = Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z)
	local look = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if look.Magnitude > 0.01 and flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and flat.Unit:Dot(look.Unit) >= Config.PickaxeFacingDot then
		return distance
	end
	return nil
end

--- Nearest cube or card-carrying player. Returns (cube, victim); at most one is set.
local function findTarget(player: Player, root: BasePart): (Part?, Player?)
	local bestDistance = math.huge
	local cube, victim
	for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Cube")) do
		if inst.Parent and not inst:GetAttribute("Dead") then
			local distance = reachDistance(root, (inst :: Part).Position)
			if distance and distance < bestDistance and LineOfSight.IsClear(root.Parent, inst, inst.Position) then
				bestDistance, cube, victim = distance, inst :: Part, nil
			end
		end
	end
	for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local otherRoot = other ~= player and CardService.GetCarried(other) and other.Character
			and other.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		local distance = otherRoot and reachDistance(root, otherRoot.Position)
		if distance and distance < bestDistance and LineOfSight.IsClear(root.Parent, other.Character, otherRoot.Position) then
			bestDistance, cube, victim = distance, nil, other
		end
	end
	return cube, victim
end

local function onSwing(player: Player, tool: Tool)
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastSwing[player] and now - lastSwing[player] < Config.SwingCooldown then return end

	local char = player.Character
	if not char or tool.Parent ~= char then return end
	local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then return end
	lastSwing[player] = now

	local animation = Instance.new("StringValue")
	animation.Name = "toolanim"
	animation.Value = "Slash"
	animation.Parent = tool
	Debris:AddItem(animation, Config.SwingCooldown) -- the client's Animate script has already read it
	local cube, victim = findTarget(player, root)
	if cube then
		CubeService.Damage(cube, Config.PickaxeDamage, player)
	elseif victim then
		CardService.DropCarried(victim)
	end
	tool.Handle[(cube or victim) and "HitSound" or "MissSound"]:Play()
end

local function hookTool(player: Player, tool: Instance)
	if not tool:IsA("Tool") or tool.Name ~= Config.PickaxeName or tool:GetAttribute("Hooked") then return end
	tool:SetAttribute("Hooked", true)
	for name, soundId in pairs(Config.PickaxeSounds) do
		local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
		sound.Name = name .. "Sound"
		sound.SoundId = soundId
		sound.Parent = tool.Handle
	end
	tool.Activated:Connect(function() onSwing(player, tool) end)
end

local function watch(player: Player, container: Instance)
	for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		hookTool(player, child)
	end
	container.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child) hookTool(player, child) end)
end

local function onCharacterAdded(player: Player, char: Model)
	watch(player, char)
	watch(player, player:WaitForChild("Backpack"))
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) onCharacterAdded(player, char) end)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(onCharacterAdded, player, player.Character)
	end
end

function PickaxeService.Init(cubeService, cardService)
	CubeService = cubeService
	CardService = cardService
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		onPlayerAdded(player)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) lastSwing[player] = nil end)
end

return PickaxeService
